method.name: milp_assignment_binary
steps: Define binary variables x[w,t] = 1 if worker w is assigned to task t, 0 otherwise
Constraint: each task gets exactly one worker (sum over workers = 1 for each task)
Constraint: each worker does at most one task (sum over tasks <= 1 for each worker)
Objective: minimize sum of hours x[w,t] * hours[w,t]
Use HiGHS direct MILP with binary variables

method.name: enumerate_exclude_one
steps: Enumerate all 5 ways to exclude one worker (leave out I, II, III, IV, or V)
For each exclusion, solve a standard 4x4 assignment problem using Hungarian algorithm
Compute optimal total hours for each exclusion
Select the exclusion that yields minimum total hours

method.name: milp_direct_integer
steps: Define binary decision variables y[w,t] for assignment
Add task coverage constraints: each task assigned to exactly 1 worker
Add worker capacity constraints: each worker at most 1 task
Add cardinality constraint: sum of all assignments = 4
Objective: minimize weighted sum of hours
Use HiGHS with all binary variables
